title: HR-Merge: Model Merging with Headroom-Weighted Residual Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.27377v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model merging combines experts fine-tuned from a shared backbone, such as LoRA adapters of a large language model, into one multi-task model without further training. Existing methods apply one rule to every task, yet the accuracy they lose is uneven across tasks. We show that the lost accuracy remains recoverable from each task's residual, its task vector minus the merged update, and that a task's validation headroom, the share of its expert validation accuracy the merge loses, indicates where recovery pays off. Residuals from different tasks interfere, so they must be merged rather than summed. We propose HR-Merge, a training-free wrapper around any merging method. It weights each residual by its task's headroom, re-merges the weighted residuals with the base operator, and adds the result back at a strength selected on validation, falling back to the base merge when no strength helps. translated_title: HR-Merge：基于余量加权残差精炼的模型合并方法
translated_abstract: 模型合并旨在将在共享主干上微调的多个专家模型（例如大语言模型的 LoRA 适配器）合并为一个多任务模型，而无需进一步训练。现有方法对每个任务采用同一合并规则，但由此造成的准确率损失在各任务之间并不均匀。我们证明，这些损失的准确率仍可从每个任务的残差（即其任务向量减去合并后的更新）中恢复，并且任务的验证余量（即合并所损失的专家验证准确率的占比）能够指示在何处进行恢复最为有效。由于来自不同任务的残差会相互干扰，因此必须对它们进行合并而非简单求和。我们提出 HR-Merge，这是一个无需训练的框架，可包裹任意现有的合并方法。它按各任务的余量对残差进行加权，用基础合并算子重新合并加权后的残差，并以在验证集上选定的强度将结果加回；当没有任何强度带来提升时，则回退到基础合并方法。在 LLaMA-3 8B 的六个 NLI 适配器上，HR-Merge 提升了……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: HR-Merge 是一种无需训练的通用模型合并增强框架，它根据各任务的验证准确率余量对其残差加权并重新合并，从而有效恢复现有合并方法在不同任务上不均匀损失的准确率。
en_tdlr: HR-Merge is a training-free wrapper for any model merging method that weights each task's residual by its validation headroom and re-merges them, recovering the unevenly lost accuracy across tasks.
